title: DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Unai Baroja
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2ptgdnn

steps.title: Heat samples and prepare labeled tubes
steps.instruction: Heat the sample tubes for 15 minutes at 65 °C in a heat block. Simultaneously add 250 µL C2 solution to empty 1.5 mL tubes, label them for later step 7, and add 200 µL C3 solution to other empty 1.5 mL tubes, label them for later step 10.

substeps.instruction: Place sample tubes in heat block; set 65 °C, 15 min.
Pipette 250 µL C2 into each empty 1.5 mL tube; label for step 7.
Pipette 200 µL C3 into each empty 1.5 mL tube; label for step 10.

steps.title: Weigh pellet samples
steps.instruction: Add the pellets to sterilised weigh trays, record the number of pellets and total weight.

steps.title: Combine pellets with bead tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the pellets into the labelled Dry Bead Tubes that already contain Bead Solution, then give a quick spin.

steps.title: Add pre‑heated C1
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of pre‑heated C1 solution to each Dry Bead Tube and vortex thoroughly for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Tissue lyse samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a Precellys Tissue Homogeniser and tissuelyse for 10 minutes at frequency 20 (2 × 20 cycles).

steps.title: Initial centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to C2 tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer 450 µL of the supernatant to the 1.5 mL tubes that contain C2 solution and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate and label spin filters
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for 5 minutes at 4 °C while labeling N spin filters and N collection tubes.

substeps.instruction: Label spin filters and collection tubes as required.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to C3 tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 600 µL of the supernatant to the 1.5 mL tubes that contain C3 solution and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate and label low‑bind tubes
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for 5 minutes at 4 °C while labeling low‑binding 1.5 mL tubes with sample names/numbers.

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer to collection tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 750 µL of the supernatant to 2 mL collection tubes.

steps.title: Add C4 solution
steps.instruction: Shake the C4 solution, add a total of 1 100 µL (550 µL + 550 µL) to the supernatant, and vortex briefly.

substeps.instruction: Invert or shake C4 tube to mix.
Pipette another 550 µL C4, add, vortex.

steps.title: Load mixture onto spin filter
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the mixture onto a spin filter, centrifuge at 8 000 g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through into a 50 mL Falcon tube. Repeat until the entire mixture has been loaded.

substeps.instruction: Collect flow‑through in 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add C5 and spin
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of C5 solution, centrifuge at 13 000 g for 1 minute, check that the liquid has passed through and discard the flow‑through. Avoid splashing C5 onto the spin filter.

steps.title: Second C5 spin and collect filter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 13 000 g for 1 minute and place the spin filter into a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add C6 and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of C6 solution to the centre of the spin filter and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Final spin and discard filter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 g for 1 minute, then discard the spin filter.

steps.title: Collect final DNA extract
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to 1.5 mL low‑binding tubes and distribute the extracts into PCR strips as needed.
